title: fix: require 12 hours before automatic relisting
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Require monitor-hidden models to remain hidden for 12 hours before automatic recovery checks
- Keep recovery proof based on the latest one-hour health window and a fresh passing probe
- Preserve immediate owner-requested and dashboard relisting

gist.headline: The garden gets a cooldown
gist.blurb: Models now get a proper 12-hour rest after being hidden before the monitor considers reopening the gate. Manual relisting still skips the nap.
gist.summary: Updated the community monitor policy so hidden models must remain hidden for 12 hours before automatic recovery checks, while retaining the latest one-hour health window, a fresh passing probe, and immediate manual or dashboard relisting.
gist.impact: Automatic relisting now has a longer stability window, helping recovered models return with fresher health evidence while owners can still relist immediately when appropriate.
gist.visual_concept: A cozy model-health garden uses a 12-hour hourglass as a gentle cooldown gate: Polli tends a resting code-plant beside a monitor showing a healthy green probe. The scene represents patient automatic recovery while preserving a clearly marked manual garden gate for immediate owner relisting.
gist.image_prompt: A cozy pixel art garden-monitor scene where Polli, a cute yellow bee mascot with dark brown stripes, black oval eyes, pink rectangular cheek blush, a small smile, light-blue translucent wings, and a tiny gardener scarf, carefully waters a resting code-plant beside a chunky 12-hour hourglass; a retro CRT monitor shows a fresh lime green (#ecf874) health check and a small gate sign reads "MANUAL OK". Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, soft lime green (#ecf874) and pastel gradient background, warm lighting, flowers and vines, retro gaming vibes like Stardew Valley or A Short Hike, nostalgic and emotionally warm.
